description: This file provides functions and types for managing bookmarks in the Multiverse Explorer application, using localStorage for persistence. It includes functions to list, add, remove, clear bookmarks, and store last selected path type, all scoped per user persona.

methods.name: listMultiverseBookmarks
methods.description: Retrieves the list of bookmarks for a given persona from localStorage, with error handling and validation.

methods.name: isMultiverseBookmarked
methods.description: Checks if a specific bookmark ID is present in the user's bookmarks.

methods.name: addMultiverseBookmark
methods.description: Adds or updates a bookmark in the user's list, with a cap of 200 entries.

methods.name: removeMultiverseBookmark
methods.description: Removes a bookmark by ID from the user's list.

methods.name: clearMultiverseBookmarks
methods.description: Clears all bookmarks for a given persona.

methods.name: getLastMultiversePathType
methods.description: Retrieves the last selected path type for the user, stored in localStorage.

methods.name: persistLastMultiversePathType
methods.description: Stores the user's last selected path type in localStorage.
